AI-Generated Drug Shows Early Promise in Slowing Aging

Early data suggests a drug generated by artificial intelligence may be capable of slowing the aging process. The drug, developed by Insilico Medicine, is reportedly showing promise in initial studies. The company's co-CEO has expressed significant optimism that the fibrosis drug could also potentially reverse aging. Further research and clinical trials are expected to determine the drug's efficacy and safety.
